## Outcome

Unify overlay appearance and lifecycle while preserving desktop dialog and native sheet behavior.

Roadmap: #1 · Milestone: M2: React and React Native components · Priority: P0 (required for v1).

## Scope

- Implement Dialog, AlertDialog/confirmation, Sheet/Drawer, Popover/Menu, and Tooltip where the audited platform matrix supports them.
- Specify modal layering, focus trapping/restoration, initial focus, escape/back/outside dismissal, scroll locking, safe areas, keyboard behavior, and sheet gesture cancellation.
- Preserve the app's touch-sized close target and accessible descriptions and Pro's density/layout choices; avoid consolidating incompatible behavior into a single undifferentiated wrapper.
- Keep native sheet/gesture/reanimated dependencies optional and separate; provide alternatives for unsupported web hover behaviors.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Nested overlays maintain correct order, focus, scroll behavior, and native back/dismissal without leaking listeners or locks.
- [ ] Keyboard, VoiceOver, TalkBack, large text, safe areas, orientation, and on-screen keyboard flows are verified.
- [ ] Every overlay has documented supported platforms, dismissal rules, accessible title/description, and open/close feedback events.
- [ ] Importing a basic component does not load overlay/native sheet dependencies.

## Prerequisites

- #15 — Build selection, toggle, range, and segmented controls for React and RN

## Completion evidence

Link implementation PRs, updated docs/examples, and relevant validation results. Record platform limitations and any remaining catalog/adoption work explicitly.
